# C-style Syntax in the Workshop

Source: [4852](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4852); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4852-n1"></a>

- Native Workshop has equivalent C-style forms for assignments, arithmetic/logic, ternary and array indexing.

<a id="wiki-4852-n2"></a>

- The exponent operator is ^ (not XOR); += and ^= map to Modify Variable operations.

Source limitations:

- Article frames the change as April 2020 PTR history; Or row uses box-drawing vertical glyphs, so do not copy its displayed symbol verbatim as executable syntax.
